blurb: Anita's Elite Dance offers a variety of dance classes including ballet, tap, jazz, hip-hop, lyrical, and tumbling, as well as vocal training and drama classes. Classes accommodate all levels from age 3 to adult. The studio emphasizes discipline, teamwork, and theatrical skills to develop well-rounded performers.
